$comment: Every defensive-perk and defensive-legendary number used by src/lib/builder/perk-defensive-layer.ts. Patch 62 renamed/reworked the cards, Patch 66 changed the order of operations (armor curve first, then multiplicative reducers), Patch 70 made Lone Wanderer apply to all damage types. 'special-scaled' entries are linear over SPECIAL 1..15 between min and max; when only the endpoints are public the entry is 'approximate' and any UI string must say so.

orderOfOperations.formula: delivered = curve(paper, DR * (1 - pen)) * PRODUCT(1 - reducer_i); Evade/Deflect are a chance layer before damage
orderOfOperations.curve: src/lib/calculator/creation-engine-math.ts calculateMitigatedDamage (0.15 / 0.365, 99% cap, boss flat reduction after the curve)

ironclad.label: Ironclad
ironclad.source: Patch 62 card text: 'Armor provides 15/20/25% more protection. Double if wearing a matching set.' No Power Armor exclusion since Patch 62.

hardy.label: Hardy
hardy.source: Patch 62 (ex-Fireproof): 'Take 15/30/45% less damage from explosions.' No fire resistance.

thick-skin.label: Thick Skin
thick-skin.source: Ghoul card: 'You take 4/6/10% less damage from Ballistic attacks. (No Power Armor)'

blocker.label: Blocker
blocker.source: Card text 'Block 15/20/25% more damage from melee attacks'; default block 60% since Patch 66.

barbarian.label: Barbarian
barbarian.source: perk-curves-p70.json perks/barbarianbonus (Patch 70 client data), read at the live STR: 1 → 18, 15 → 61, 30 → 96, 60 → 131, 100 → 175. Doubled when wearing no armor. Until 2026-10-12 the min/max pair was spread over SPECIAL 1..15, which read the x = 100 value at 15.

evasive.label: Evasive
evasive.source: perk-curves-p70.json perks/evasivebonus (Patch 70 client data), read at the live AGI: 1 → 2, 15 → 6, 30 → 9, 60 → 12, 100 → 14. No Power Armor; not while over-encumbered. Until 2026-10-12 the min/max pair was spread over SPECIAL 1..15, which read the x = 100 value at 15.

moving-target.label: Moving Target
moving-target.source: Card text '+5/10/15% chance to Evade while sprinting. (No Power Armor)'

dodgy.label: Dodgy
dodgy.source: Card text '+5% chance to Evade. Evade no longer has a cooldown. Instead it costs AP.'

serendipity.label: Serendipity
serendipity.source: perk-curves-p70.json perks/serendipitybonus (Patch 70 client data), read at the live LCK: 1 → 6, 15 → 16, 30 → 25, 60 → 35, 100 → 40. Evade chance below 30% health; no Power Armor. Until 2026-10-12 the min/max pair was spread over SPECIAL 1..15, which read the x = 100 value at 15.

ricochet.label: Ricochet
ricochet.source: perk-curves-p70.json perks/ricochetbonus (Patch 70 client data), read at the live LCK: 1 → 4, 15 → 14, 30 → 20, 60 → 30, 100 → 35. Deflect chance against ranged attacks. Until 2026-10-12 the min/max pair was spread over SPECIAL 1..15, which read the x = 100 value at 15.

bullet-shield.label: Bullet Shield
bullet-shield.source: Card text 'Gain 5/10/15% Deflect chance for 6 sec when firing a heavy gun.'

lone-wanderer.label: Lone Wanderer
lone-wanderer.source: perk-curves-p70.json perks/lonewandererdrbonus (Patch 70 client data), read at the live CHA: 1 → 0.99, 15 → 0.9, 30 → 0.86, 60 → 0.83, 100 → 0.8. The curve is the incoming-damage multiplier (0.99 → 0.80); the reduction is 1 − value. All damage types since Patch 70; AP regen (perks/lonewandererapregenbonus) not modelled here. Until 2026-10-12 the 0.80 (x = 100) value was read at CHA 15.

bodyguards.label: Bodyguards
bodyguards.source: perk-curves-p70.json perks/bodyguardsbonus (Patch 70 client data), read at the live CHA: 1 → 4, 15 → 15, 30 → 24, 60 → 32, 100 → 43. Read as DR and ER per teammate (max 3), the model this pack already used; the per-teammate reading of the curve is an assumption. Until 2026-10-12 the min/max pair was spread over SPECIAL 1..15, which read the x = 100 value at 15.

refractor.label: Refractor
refractor.source: perk-curves-p70.json perks/refractorbonus (Patch 70 client data), read at the live PER: 1 → 18, 15 → 61, 30 → 96, 60 → 131, 100 → 175. Until 2026-10-12 the min/max pair was spread over SPECIAL 1..15, which read the x = 100 value at 15.

rad-resistant.label: Rad Resistant
rad-resistant.source: perk-curves-p70.json perks/radresistantbonus (Patch 70 client data), read at the live END: 1 → 18, 15 → 61, 30 → 96, 60 → 131, 100 → 175. Until 2026-10-12 the min/max pair was spread over SPECIAL 1..15, which read the x = 100 value at 15.

junk-shield.label: Junk Shield
junk-shield.source: Card text 'Resistances based on LCK and amount of junk held'; range unpublished, modelled 0..30 (old rank 3 total) with junk held.

lifegiver.label: Lifegiver
lifegiver.source: Card text 'max HP based on END'; range unpublished, modelled +0..+45%.

iron-stomach.label: Iron Stomach
iron-stomach.source: perk-curves-p70.json perks/ironstomachbonus (Patch 70 client data), read at the live END: 1 → 18, 15 → 61, 30 → 96, 60 → 131, 100 → 175. DR and ER while not diseased. Until 2026-10-12 the min/max pair was spread over SPECIAL 1..15, which read the x = 100 value at 15.

natural-resistance.label: Natural Resistance
natural-resistance.source: perk-curves-p70.json perks/naturalresistancebonus (Patch 70 client data), read at the live END: 1 → 10, 15 → 35, 30 → 55, 60 → 75, 100 → 100. Fire, cryo and poison resistance while not diseased. Until 2026-10-12 the min/max pair was spread over SPECIAL 1..15, which read the x = 100 value at 15.

adamantium-skeleton.label: Adamantium Skeleton
adamantium-skeleton.source: Patch 70 card text: 'Gain Limb Damage Reduction based on your END.' The sheet has no limb-damage model (limb HP is separate from the DR/ER curve), so this is a note only. Legacy three ranks reduced limb damage by 30/60/100%; the END curve since Patch 62 is unpublished.

vaccinated.label: Vaccinated
vaccinated.source: Patch 70 card text: 'Increased Disease Resistance based on END.' Disease resistance is not a sheet stat (it only lowers the chance of catching a disease), so this is a note only. Legacy three ranks were 30/60/90% disease resistance from creature attacks; the END curve since Patch 62 is unpublished.

sturdy-frame.label: Sturdy Frame
sturdy-frame.source: Patch 70 card text: 'You are 25/50% harder to stagger.' Stagger is not modelled by the defensive profile (it is a hit-reaction chance, not damage), so the rank value is surfaced as a note. Pre-Patch 62 the card lowered armor weight instead.

natural-stance.label: Natural Stance
natural-stance.source: Patch 70 card text: 'While equipping a melee weapon, reduce Incoming Stagger by 25%.' Stagger is not modelled; note only.

brick-wall.label: Brick Wall
brick-wall.source: Patch 70 Ghoul card text: 'When your Glow is high, makes you immune to staggering attacks.' Stagger is not modelled; note only.

nerd-rage.label: Nerd Rage
nerd-rage.source: Patch 62: damage and AP regen as health drops; no Damage Resistance any more. The damage part is perk-curves-p70.json perks/nerdragedamagebonus (+80% at 5% HP, +40% at 20%, +1% at 80%), applied in combat-firepower-engine.ts.

tenderizer.label: Tenderizer
tenderizer.source: +0.1% damage taken by the target per hit, stacks to +100%, no expiry, not PvP. Offensive: not part of the defensive profile.

vanguards.label: Vanguard's
vanguards.source: Up to 10% damage reduction, full at 1000 max HP; modelled as full at 100% current HP, linear. Stacking across pieces unverified: modelled once per set.

bolstering.label: Bolstering
bolstering.source: Up to 10% damage reduction, full at 5% HP, linear towards 0 at 100% HP. Stacking across pieces unverified: modelled once per set.

mutants.label: Mutant's
mutants.source: 1% damage reduction per mutation, up to 5%. Stacking across pieces unverified: modelled once per set.

cavaliers.label: Cavalier's
cavaliers.source: 10% less damage while sprinting (was 15% chance of 75% reduction before Patch 66).

sentinels.label: Sentinel's
sentinels.source: 5% less damage while standing still, per current datamine text.

unstoppable-monster.label: Unstoppable Monster
unstoppable-monster.source: 5% damage reduction plus 1% per kill-streak stack; cap unpublished, modelled uncapped.

last-stand.label: Last Stand
last-stand.source: Unique chest: converts Evade chance x0.5 into damage reduction and disables Evade.

the-action-hero.label: The Action Hero
the-action-hero.source: +1% Deflect chance per Bullet Storm stack.

evadeDeflect.source: Deflect reflects 100% of a ranged hit and the player takes 50% of it; +50% Deflect chance multiplier in heavy armor or Power Armor.

powerArmorInnate.source: Claimed 7%/15% innate reduction per Power Armor piece is unverified; constant kept at 0 and exposed as a toggle labelled unverified.
